note: Inyo NF campground along Convict Creek a short walk below Convict Lake, two miles off Hwy 395 between Mammoth Lakes and Bishop. Many sites are flat; a bear locker at each. The dump station is on Convict Lake Road a quarter-mile away; showers (fee), store, restaurant and boat rentals are at Convict Lake Resort next door. The lake is no-wake. --Claude
summary: Convict Lake (Inyo NF): FS page + rec.gov 234311 (rules, rates, catalog, Oct calendar) + alerts + Esri/3DEP. Confirmed $35; added $10 extra vehicle, 6-person cap, 85 sites (48 reservable -> some_sites), weekend/holiday soft minimums, 4-day cutoff, 04-24..10-24 season; toilets are flush, not vault. Creekside kept (sites 33/27 ~45-60 m from the creek, ~2 m above). Pin moves ~360 m off the resort cabins onto the loops.
flags: PIN MOVE (~360 m): stored 37.59800,-118.85250 sits in the Convict Lake Resort cabin cluster west of the access road. Target 37.59712,-118.84861 (centroid of the 48 catalog sites, on the campground loop east of Convict Creek). FS page point 37.59483,-118.848072 is also on the loops.

WATERFRONT: stored 'creekside' kept. Esri + 3DEP: Convict Creek's channel (low 2292 m at 37.5983,-118.8487) runs through the riparian strip west of the loop; site 33 (37.598667,-118.848302) is ~45 m east of it at ~2294 m and site 27 (37.598335,-118.848052) ~60 m at ~2294 m, an easy walk down a gentle slope through willows. Both are reservable by the night. Not lakefront: recreation.gov notices on many sites say 'Not a shoreline site. 300ft to shoreline'; the lake is ~300 m from the southern loop with the resort road, marina and day-use parking between.
FACILITIES: stored vault_toilets true is contradicted by both FS ('Flush toilet(s)') and recreation.gov ('Flush toilets'); cleared to null and flush_toilets set true.
PHONE: stored 760-924-5500 is the Mammoth Lakes Welcome Center (the FS page's contact); recreation.gov lists facility phone 760-924-5771. No change proposed.
SEASON: earlier years carried a cheaper first-come 'Walk-Up Season' into late October ($30); 2026 and 2027 rate tables show none, so a post-season first-come stretch is unconfirmed.
